repos.description: Python tool for converting files and office documents to Markdown.
repos.summary_zh: 微软开源Python工具，将Office文档、PDF、音视频等30+格式转换为Markdown。专为LLM和文本分析管道设计，保留标题、列表、表格等结构，输出token高效。集成OCR、语音转录、YouTube下载等能力，提供MCP服务器供Claude等LLM应用调用。流式处理无临时文件，插件化架构支持扩展。
repos.summary_en: Microsoft's open-source Python utility converts 30+ file formats (Office documents, PDF, images, audio, HTML, etc.) to Markdown for LLM and text analysis pipelines. Preserves document structure—headings, lists, tables, links—with token-efficient output. Integrates OCR, speech transcription, YouTube processing, and MCP server for Claude/LLM integration. Stream-based processing eliminates temporary files; plugin architecture enables custom converters.

repos.description: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供一套生产就绪的AI代理团队，涵盖前端、后端、移动开发等专业领域。每个代理具备独特人格、专业工作流和可量化交付物，支持Claude Code、GitHub Copilot等主流工具。通过标准化提示工程与自动化脚本，将通用AI助手转化为具备领域专长的虚拟员工，实现软件开发全流程的智能化升级。
repos.summary_en: This repository delivers a production-ready AI agent team covering frontend, backend, mobile development, and more. Each agent features unique personality, specialized workflows, and measurable deliverables, compatible with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and other mainstream tools. By standardizing prompt engineering with automation scripts, it transforms generic AI assistants into domain-specialized virtual employees, enabling intelligent upgrades across the entire software development lifecycle.

repos.description: Turn any idea, plan, or codebase into a beautiful interactive diagram. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, and more.
repos.summary_zh: Archify 是一款 AI 代理技能工具，能将自然语言描述转化为精美的架构图、工作流图、序列图、数据流图和生命周期图。生成自包含 HTML，支持暗/亮主题一键切换、剪贴板复制及最高 4 倍原生分辨率导出（PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG）。SVG 支持系统主题偏好。集成 Claude 等平台，无需设计技能，通过聊天指令迭代优化。核心价值是提升技术文档和可视化效率，适用于系统架构、DevOps 流程及数据管道等场景。
repos.summary_en: Archify is an agent skill for AI tools like Claude that generates high-quality architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams from plain English text. It outputs self-contained HTML files featuring instant dark/light theme toggles, clipboard PNG copy, and native 4× resolution exports in PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG. SVGs include dual themes with media queries for automatic adaptation. Requiring no design expertise, it supports conversational refinements and is ideal for technical documentation, system design, CI/CD pipelines, and data engineering visualizations.

repos.description: Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents. CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是一个专为AI编码代理设计的营销技能集合，以Markdown文件形式提供CRO、文案写作、SEO、数据分析和增长工程等专业工作流。基于Agent Skills规范构建，技能相互引用并以product-marketing为基础，提供产品、受众与定位上下文。适用于Claude Code、Cursor等工具，帮助技术营销者和创始人通过AI代理实现营销任务自动化与优化。
repos.summary_en: This repository delivers a curated collection of markdown-based skills for AI coding agents, specializing in CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering. Built to the Agent Skills spec, skills interconnect with product-marketing as the foundational layer providing product, audience, and positioning context. It empowers technical marketers and founders using Claude Code, Cursor, and similar agents to automate and optimize marketing workflows efficiently.

repos.description: Self-evolving Context Database for AI Agents. Unify Agent Memory, Knowledge RAG and Skills.
repos.summary_zh: OpenViking是专为AI Agent设计的开源上下文数据库，创新性地采用文件系统范式统一管理记忆、资源与技能，解决碎片化问题。核心亮点包括：L0/L1/L2分层加载大幅降低token成本；目录递归检索结合语义搜索提升精度；检索轨迹可视化打破RAG黑盒；自动会话管理实现上下文自演进。
repos.summary_en: OpenViking is an open-source context database designed for AI Agents. It unifies memory, resources, and skills via a filesystem paradigm. Key features include tiered loading (L0/L1/L2) to reduce token consumption, directory-recursive retrieval for improved precision, visualized retrieval trajectories for full observability, and automatic session management enabling self-evolving, adaptive context.

repos.description: An AI prompt optimizer for writing better prompts and getting better AI results.
repos.summary_zh: Prompt Optimizer 是一款专注于提示词工程优化的 AI 应用工具，支持多模型集成与 MCP 协议。通过智能优化、对比测试和高级调试模式，显著提升 LLM 输出质量与稳定性。提供 Web、桌面、Chrome 插件及 Docker 多端部署，采用纯前端架构确保数据安全，适用于角色扮演、知识提取等场景。
repos.summary_en: Prompt Optimizer is a powerful AI application tool dedicated to prompt engineering optimization, supporting multi-model integration and MCP protocol compatibility. It significantly improves LLM output quality and stability through intelligent prompt refinement, real-time A/B testing, and advanced debugging features including context variables and function calling. The tool offers versatile deployment options—Web, desktop, Chrome extension, and Docker—with a pure frontend architecture that ensures data security by processing everything client-side. Perfect for scenarios like roleplay simulation, knowledge graph extraction, and creative writing collaboration.

repos.description: [EMNLP 2025 Demo] PDF scientific paper translation with preserved formats - 基于 AI 完整保留排版的 PDF 文档全文双语翻译，支持 Google/DeepL/Ollama/OpenAI 等服务，提供 CLI/GUI/MCP/Docker/Zotero
repos.summary_zh: PDFMathTranslate 是一款专注于科技文献的PDF翻译工具，核心优势在于完整保留原始排版。支持公式、图表、目录、注释等复杂元素的精准定位与翻译。集成Google、DeepL、Ollama、OpenAI等多引擎，提供CLI、GUI、Docker及Zotero插件等多种使用方式。适用于学术研究、论文阅读等场景，支持多语言互译，确保学术文档的专业性与可读性。
repos.summary_en: PDFMathTranslate is a specialized PDF translation tool for scientific documents that preserves original layouts with high fidelity. It accurately handles complex elements including formulas, charts, tables of contents, and annotations. The tool integrates multiple translation backends such as Google, DeepL, Ollama, and OpenAI, offering flexible deployment via CLI, GUI, Docker, and Zotero plugins. Designed for academic research and paper reading, it supports multilingual translation while maintaining the professional quality and readability of scholarly documents.

repos.description: Prompt as Code | GPT Image 2 / 2.5 提示词与案例库，530+ 个案例、20+ 套工业级模板与可复用 Skills，新增 2.5 同提示词对比专区，附完整提示词与生成记录，持续更新。
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是GPT-Image2的Prompt as Code工业级提示词引擎与模板库，逆向工程506+案例，涵盖UI、Poster、产品等13类场景，提炼20+工业模板与Agent Skills。配套网站支持提示浏览、复制、筛选与测试生成，助力专业AI图像生成与自动化工作流，持续更新。
repos.summary_en: The awesome-gpt-image-2 repository provides an industrial-grade Prompt as Code engine and template library for GPT-Image2. It features over 506 reverse-engineered cases across 13 categories including UI, posters, products, and photography, plus 20+ industrial templates and Agent Skills. A companion website enables browsing, copying prompts, filtering by style or scene, and testing generations. Designed for professional AI image generation, automation workflows, and agent integration with ongoing updates.

repos.description: Uncensored Open-source alternative to AI video platforms — Free AI image & video generation studio with 800+ models (Flux, Midjourney, Kling, Sora, Veo). No content filters. Self-hosted, MIT licensed.
repos.summary_zh: 开源AI媒体生成工作室，集成200+先进模型（Flux、Sora、Kling等），提供无过滤的图像视频创作环境。支持自托管与跨平台桌面应用，通过AI编码代理实现提示→生成→编辑→合成的全流程自动化，是商业AI平台的开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Open-source AI media generation studio integrating 200+ state-of-the-art models (Flux, Sora, Kling) for unfiltered image/video creation. Features self-hosting, cross-platform desktop apps, and AI agent automation for end-to-end media pipeline orchestration. MIT-licensed alternative to commercial platforms.

repos.description: Free, local plugin that keeps tool output out of your coding agent's context window. Sandbox and SQLite FTS5 search, 99% fewer bytes in context. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OMP, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI and 4 more agents. Zero telemetry.
repos.summary_zh: Context Mode 是面向 AI 编码代理的上下文优化工具。作为 MCP 服务器，它通过沙箱工具输出实现 98% 上下文减少，支持 15 个平台集成。利用 SQLite 追踪会话并以 FTS5/BM25 检索关键信息，倡导代码执行范式处理数据。集成 Claude、Cursor 等 IDE，已获微软、谷歌团队采用。
repos.summary_en: Context Mode optimizes context windows for AI coding agents as an MCP server. It sandboxes tool outputs for 98% reduction, e.g., 315KB to 5.4KB. SQLite with FTS5 and BM25 ensures session continuity by indexing and retrieving relevant events on compaction. 'Think in code' via ctx_* tools lets agents script data processing instead of loading raw data. Supports 15 platforms like Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code Copilot via plugins and hooks. Adopted by Microsoft, Google, Meta teams.

repos.description: Memory and context engine + app that is extremely fast, scalable, and can be run fully locally. The Memory API for the AI era.
repos.summary_zh: supermemory 是一个高性能、可扩展的AI记忆引擎，定位为用户的'第二大脑'。核心亮点在于支持MCP协议，可无缝集成Claude、Cursor等AI工具，实现智能记忆检索与对话。支持URL、PDF、文本等多格式内容导入，提供浏览器插件和Raycast扩展。采用API优先设计，既可作为个人知识管理平台，也能通过开发者控制台集成到企业工作流，支持自托管部署。
repos.summary_en: Supermemory is a high-performance, scalable AI memory engine positioned as your 'second brain.' Its core strength lies in MCP protocol integration, enabling seamless connectivity with AI tools like Claude and Cursor for intelligent memory retrieval and chat. It supports multi-format content import (URLs, PDFs, text) via browser extensions and Raycast. API-first design allows both personal knowledge management and enterprise workflow integration through its developer console, with self-hosting options available.

repos.description: Make Any Website into CLI & Use your logged-in browser by AI agent.
repos.summary_zh: OpenCLI 是一款将任意网站转换为命令行接口的自动化工具，核心在于让 AI 智能体通过已登录的浏览器操作网页（导航、填表、点击、数据提取）。内置 Bilibili、知乎等适配器，通过浏览器扩展与本地守护进程实现安全交互，支持自定义命令扩展，并集成本地工具与 Electron 应用，实现高效自动化与 AI 驱动交互。
repos.summary_en: OpenCLI is an automation tool that converts any website into a command-line interface (CLI), enabling AI agents to operate websites via a logged-in browser for navigation, form filling, clicking, and data extraction. It provides built-in adapters for platforms like Bilibili and Zhihu, a browser extension with a local daemon, and allows custom command extensions. It also integrates local tools and Electron apps, serving as a versatile hub for human and AI-driven automation workflows.

repos.description: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI Agents — turning conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks.
repos.summary_zh: TencentDB Agent Memory 为 AI Agent 提供完全本地的长期记忆解决方案，采用 4 层渐进式管道（L0 Conversation→L1 Atom→L2 Scenario→L3 Persona）实现符号化短期记忆与分层长期记忆。拒绝平铺向量存储，通过 Mermaid 符号图与异构存储（DB+Markdown）实现渐进披露与全 traceable 召回。集成 OpenClaw/Hermes 后，Token 消耗最高降 61.38%，任务通过率相对提升 51.52%，PersonaMem 准确率从 48% 升至 76%。适用于长程 Agent 任务与个性化体验，零外部 API 依赖。
repos.summary_en: TencentDB Agent Memory delivers fully local long-term memory for AI Agents via a 4-tier progressive pipeline (L0 Conversation → L1 Atom → L2 Scenario → L3 Persona), combining symbolic short-term memory with layered long-term memory. It rejects flat vector storage, using Mermaid symbol graphs and heterogeneous storage (DB + Markdown) for progressive disclosure and full traceability. When integrated with OpenClaw/Hermes, it cuts token usage by up to 61.38%, boosts task success by up to 51.52% relatively, and raises PersonaMem accuracy from 48% to 76%. Ideal for long-horizon agent tasks and personalization, with zero external API dependencies.

repos.description: Huashu Design 3.0 · 在 agent 里打一句话，拿回能交付的设计：网页 / App 原型 / 可编辑 PPTX / 动画 / 信息图 · 六个候选挑三个方向 · 84 种带样张的风格库 · 越用越懂你的外观账本与设计体检 · HTML-native design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor & any agent
repos.summary_zh: 华数设计是一款HTML原生的AI设计技能，可将文本描述直接转化为可交付的生产级设计稿。支持Claude Code等主流AI编程助手，3-30分钟内生成可点击的App原型、演讲幻灯片、60秒动画及信息图。核心亮点包括：20种内置设计哲学与5维评审体系确保专业品质；Motion Design引擎支持时间轴动画与MP4/GIF导出；HTML幻灯片可转为可编辑PPTX；Tweaks面板实现参数化实时调整。无需Figma插件，纯文本交互，输出印刷级排版与跨平台HTML文件。
repos.summary_en: Huashu Design is an HTML-native AI design skill that transforms text prompts into production-ready deliverables within 3-30 minutes. Compatible with Claude Code and other AI agents, it generates clickable App prototypes, presentation slides, motion graphics, and infographics. Key features include: 20 built-in design philosophies with 5-dimension expert review system; Motion Design engine supporting timeline animation and MP4/GIF export; HTML slides convertible to editable PPTX; Tweaks panel for parametric adjustments. No Figma plugins needed—pure text interface delivers print-quality layouts and cross-platform HTML output.

repos.description: 🔥 Clone and recreate any website as a modern React app in seconds
repos.summary_zh: Open Lovable 是 Firecrawl 团队开源的 AI 驱动 React 应用生成器。通过对话式交互，用户可快速克隆并重构任意网站为现代化 React 应用。核心集成 Firecrawl 网页抓取、多 LLM 提供商（OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Groq）及 Vercel/E2B 沙盒环境，实现从 URL 到可运行代码的秒级生成，支持快速迭代与实时预览，适用于原型设计与网站迁移。
repos.summary_en: Open Lovable is an open-source AI-powered React app generator by the Firecrawl team. It enables instant cloning and modernization of any website into React applications through conversational AI interaction. The project integrates Firecrawl for web scraping, multiple LLM providers (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Groq), and sandbox environments (Vercel/E2B) to transform URLs into runnable code within seconds, supporting rapid prototyping and website migration with real-time preview capabilities.

repos.description: PM Skills Marketplace: 100+ agentic skills, commands, and plugins — from discovery to strategy, execution, launch, and growth.
repos.summary_zh: PM Skills Marketplace是产品管理AI技能市场，提供68个PM技能和42个链式工作流，覆盖9个插件。它将Teresa Torres、Marty Cagan等专家框架编码为结构化流程，支持Claude等AI助手的发现、策略、执行到增长全生命周期。通过/discover等命令链式调用技能，实现假设映射、PRD撰写等严谨任务，提升产品决策质量，而非仅生成文本。兼容多AI工具，安装便捷。
repos.summary_en: PM Skills Marketplace delivers 68 PM skills and 42 chained workflows across 9 plugins for AI assistants like Claude. It encodes proven frameworks from experts such as Teresa Torres and Marty Cagan into structured processes covering discovery, strategy, execution, launch, and growth. Commands like /discover chain skills for assumption mapping, PRD writing, and metrics definition. Designed for Claude Code and Cowork with broad compatibility, it provides rigorous, decision-focused workflows instead of generic text, enhancing product outcomes through embedded PM expertise.

repos.description: :rocket: The Ultimate Image Uploader for Efficient Creators. Supports Obsidian, Typora, VS Code etc. and 60+ image hosting services  (S3, GitHub, Cloudflare R2, Imgur, Aliyun OSS...). Paste, upload, done.
repos.summary_zh: PicGo是专为创作者设计的终极图片上传工具，无缝集成Obsidian、VS Code、Typora等主流编辑器。支持60+图床服务（GitHub、阿里云OSS、S3等），通过拖拽/粘贴/快捷键实现秒传并自动复制链接。独创插件系统可扩展支持Cloudflare R2等新兴存储，彻底消除写作中的上下文切换，让创作者专注内容生产。
repos.summary_en: PicGo is the ultimate image uploader for efficient creators, seamlessly integrating with Obsidian, VS Code, Typora and other editors. Supporting 60+ image hosts (GitHub, Alibaba Cloud OSS, AWS S3), it enables instant uploads via drag-and-drop/clipboard/hotkeys with auto-copied links. Its extensible plugin system adds support for Cloudflare R2 and more, eliminating context switching to maximize creative focus.

repos.description: Readest is a modern, feature-rich ebook reader designed for avid readers offering seamless cross-platform access, powerful tools, and an intuitive interface to elevate your reading experience.
repos.summary_zh: Readest 是一款基于 Next.js 16 和 Tauri v2 构建的开源电子书阅读器，覆盖桌面、移动及 Web 全平台。支持 EPUB/MOBI/AZW3 等主流格式，提供分屏并行阅读、代码语法高亮、全文检索与智能笔记等深度功能，专为追求沉浸式体验的深度阅读者打造。
repos.summary_en: Readest is a modern, open-source ebook reader engineered for immersive reading experiences. Leveraging Next.js 16 and Tauri v2, it delivers native performance across macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, iOS, and web platforms. Supporting EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, CBZ, TXT, and experimental PDF formats, it features split-screen parallel reading, code syntax highlighting, full-text search, dictionary lookup, and comprehensive annotation tools. Built as a sophisticated rewrite of Foliate, Readest combines powerful library management with customizable reading settings to serve avid readers and technical professionals.

repos.description: Roo Code gives you a whole dev team of AI agents in your code editor.
repos.summary_zh: RooCode是VS Code扩展，提供多模式AI开发团队。支持代码生成、架构设计、调试、文档编写等全流程任务，集成MCP服务器实现工具扩展，通过自然语言指令驱动AI代理完成编程工作。
repos.summary_en: RooCode is a VS Code extension that embeds a complete AI-powered development team directly in your code editor. It provides specialized modes including Code for everyday tasks, Architect for system design, Ask for explanations, Debug for issue tracing, and customizable modes for team workflows. The extension integrates with MCP servers for extensible tooling and enables natural language-driven code generation, refactoring, debugging, documentation writing, and task automation.

repos.description: Translate the video from one language to another and embed dubbing & subtitles.
repos.summary_zh: pyVideoTrans 是一款开源视频翻译工具，提供从语音识别、字幕翻译、AI配音到音视频合成的完整自动化流程。支持本地与云端多种 ASR、LLM 和 TTS 模型，集成 F5-TTS 等语音克隆技术，可区分多角色配音。具备交互式编辑、命令行操作及跨平台部署能力，适用于内容创作者与开发者实现高效视频本地化。
repos.summary_en: pyVideoTrans is a powerful open-source video translation toolkit that automates the entire pipeline from speech recognition to AI dubbing and subtitle embedding. It integrates local and cloud APIs for ASR, LLM translation, and TTS, featuring voice cloning (F5-TTS, CosyVoice), multi-role speaker diarization, and interactive proofreading. Supports both GUI and CLI operation across Windows, macOS, and Linux, enabling efficient batch processing and video localization for content creators and developers.

repos.description: Self-hosted, plugin-based server management.
repos.summary_zh: Termix是一款开源自托管的Web服务器管理平台，为系统管理员提供一体化运维解决方案。核心功能包括：全功能SSH终端（支持分屏与标签页）、SSH隧道管理（自动重连与健康监测）、远程文件管理（支持代码/媒体编辑与Sudo权限）、Docker容器管控及服务器监控（CPU/内存/磁盘/防火墙）。采用React+Tailwind构建现代化响应式界面，支持RBAC权限体系、OIDC/2FA认证与SQLite数据库加密，是Termius的开源免费替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Termix is an open-source, self-hosted web platform for comprehensive server infrastructure management. It provides a full-featured SSH terminal with split-screen and tab support, automated SSH tunneling with health monitoring, and a remote file manager with sudo privileges. The platform integrates Docker container management, real-time server monitoring (CPU/memory/disk/network/firewall), and RBAC-based team collaboration. Built with React and Tailwind CSS, it features OIDC/2FA authentication, encrypted SQLite storage, and automatic SSL setup, serving as a free, all-in-one alternative to commercial solutions like Termius.

repos.description: The open-source Claude Motion & CapCut alternative. Turn a reference video into editable motion graphics with your brand kit. Export MP4s for YouTube, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok. A full-stack agentic video studio with 300+ Motion.md guides and support for 22 agents, including Claude Code, Codex, DSH, and WorkBuddy.
repos.summary_zh: OpenMotion 是首个全栈智能体视频生成器，支持上传参考视频或粘贴链接，通过 HTML 编码视频，用自有品牌素材重新创作。内置 Motion.md 格式描述镜头顺序与转场，支持 BYOA/BYOK，集成图像、视频、音乐和语音生成。
repos.summary_en: OpenMotion is the first full-stack agentic video generator. Upload a reference video or paste a social link to recreate it with your own brand kit. Code video with HTML, edit timing in Studio, and render MP4. Features Motion.md format for shot order, timing, and transitions. Supports BYOA/BYOK with 22 local agents and built-in models for images, video, music, and voice.

repos.description: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes your Chrome browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex browser automation, content analysis, and semantic search.
repos.summary_zh: Chrome MCP Server是一款基于Chrome扩展的Model Context Protocol服务器，让AI助手直接控制用户现有浏览器。核心优势在于复用日常Chrome环境的登录状态与配置，实现隐私优先的本地自动化。提供20+工具支持截图、网络监控、书签管理等，内置SIMD加速的向量数据库实现智能语义搜索，跨标签页上下文感知，适用于复杂浏览器自动化与内容分析场景。
repos.summary_en: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol server that transforms your existing Chrome browser into an AI-controlled automation tool. Unlike Playwright-based solutions, it directly leverages your daily browser with preserved login states and configurations, ensuring privacy through local execution. It offers 20+ tools for screenshots, network monitoring, bookmark management, and more, plus SIMD-accelerated vector search for semantic content discovery. Cross-tab context awareness enables complex browser automation and intelligent content analysis for any LLM or chatbot client.

repos.description: Self-evolving memory OS for LLM & AI Agents: ultra-persistent memory, hybrid-retrieval, and cross-task skill reuse, with 35.24% token savings and DeepSeek Harness support.
repos.summary_zh: MemOS是面向LLM与AI Agent的自演化记忆操作系统，统一长期记忆的存/取/管，支持多模态、图结构API、MemCube知识库与混合检索。实现跨任务技能复用、异步调度与反馈校正，显著降低Token消耗，兼容DeepSeek Harness等生态，赋能持久上下文与个性化Agent。
repos.summary_en: MemOS is a self-evolving Memory Operating System for LLMs and AI Agents, unifying store/retrieve/manage of long-term memory with multi-modal support, graph-structured API, MemCube knowledge bases and hybrid retrieval. It enables cross-task skill reuse, async scheduling and feedback correction, delivering major token savings and DeepSeek Harness compatibility for persistent, personalized agents.

repos.description: Automated penetration testing & attack surface management platform. Recon, scan, exploit, report - 600+ exploits, 90+ integrations, 10K+ detections.
repos.summary_zh: Sn1per是一款自动化渗透测试与攻击面管理平台，整合侦察、漏洞扫描、漏洞利用与报告生成于统一工作区。内置600+漏洞利用、90+工具集成与上万检测规则，支持Community到Enterprise多版本，适用于个人红队与SOC团队的全流程攻防作业。
repos.summary_en: Sn1per is an automated penetration testing and attack surface management platform that unifies recon, scanning, exploitation and reporting. It orchestrates 90+ tools, ships 600+ exploits and 10K+ detections, with Community to Enterprise editions for solo pentesters and global SOC teams.

repos.description: Make bilingual epub books Using AI translate
repos.summary_zh: bilingual_book_maker 是一款基于 AI 的电子书双语翻译工具，支持 epub/txt/pdf/srt 格式。核心亮点包括：集成 GPT-4、Claude、Gemini 等多款大模型，通过 litellm 统一管理非 OpenAI 模型；支持上下文感知翻译保持语义连贯；自动在多模型间负载均衡规避速率限制；提供 CLI 命令行工具，专为公版书设计，避免版权风险。
repos.summary_en: bilingual_book_maker is an AI-powered tool for creating bilingual e-books from epub/txt/pdf/srt files. Key features: integrates multiple LLMs including GPT-4, Claude, and Gemini via litellm for unified non-OpenAI model management; context-aware translation preserves semantic coherence across paragraphs; automatic load balancing across models prevents rate limiting and optimizes API costs; provides CLI for batch processing; specifically designed for public domain works to avoid copyright infringement risks while supporting parallel API keys.

repos.description: The world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool and the first to feature concurrent Agent Teams. Design-as-Code. Turn prompts into UI directly on the live canvas. A modern alternative to Pencil.
repos.summary_zh: 全球首个开源AI原生矢量设计工具，首创并发Agent Teams协同架构，支持多模型智能调度与MCP服务。通过自然语言提示实时流式生成UI，提供Design-as-Code的JSON格式，实现跨平台AI驱动的设计到代码全流程。
repos.summary_en: The world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool featuring concurrent Agent Teams for parallel UI generation. Transforms natural language prompts into live canvas designs with streaming animation, offering Design-as-Code JSON format and MCP server integration for cross-platform AI-driven design-to-code workflows.

repos.description: Open-source auth gateway connecting 1700+ SaaS providers to AI agents through SDK, CLI, MCP, HTTP, and OpenAPI.
repos.summary_zh: OpenConnector 是开源 AI 智能体连接网关，替代 Pipedream/Composio。一次授权连接 1500+ SaaS（GitHub、Gmail、Notion 等），通过 SDK、CLI、MCP、HTTP/OpenAPI 暴露 10000+ 预置 Actions。支持凭证管理、可检查 Action 契约、策略控制与运行日志，可自托管（Docker/Node/K8s）或使用 OOMOL 托管运行时。
repos.summary_en: OpenConnector is an open-source auth gateway for AI agents, an alternative to Pipedream/Composio. Connect 1500+ SaaS providers once and expose 10,000+ prebuilt Actions via SDK, CLI, MCP, HTTP and OpenAPI. It handles credentials, inspectable contracts, policies and logs, supporting self-hosting (Docker/Node/K8s) or OOMOL-hosted runtime.

repos.description: Matt Pocock skills 的简体中文本地化：人工审核每一次更新，定期同步上游，支持 Claude、Codex 和 DSH 插件。
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是 mattpocock/skills 的简体中文本地化版本，旨在更好适配中文大语言模型和中文开发者。采用 skill-guided content localization 策略，仅翻译自然语言说明，保留技能名、命令、代码块和路径不变，确保安装运行完全兼容。提供工程、生产力等领域的 AI 技能，支持中文提示工程，降低概念转换成本，方便中文开发流程与 coding agent 集成。同步上游更新并通过翻译验证。
repos.summary_en: This repository is the Simplified Chinese localization of mattpocock/skills, optimized for Chinese large language models and native developers. It applies a skill-guided content localization strategy, translating only natural language while preserving skill names, commands, code blocks, paths, and identifiers to ensure full installation and runtime compatibility. It delivers AI skills across engineering and productivity domains, enabling Chinese prompt engineering with reduced cognitive load and seamless integration into Chinese development workflows. Updates are synced from upstream with rigorous validation.

repos.description: Persistent memory for Claude Code, Codex and 6 other AI agents, stored as plain markdown in your Obsidian vault. New: Crew, one shared logbook so Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Grok Bot know what each other did. 48 commands: semantic search, self-rewriting notes, key-less research, scheduled agents.
repos.summary_zh: obsidian-second-brain 将 Obsidian vault 转变为跨 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 和 OpenCode 四 CLI 的活 AI 第二大脑。43 命令实现笔记自重写、自动知识合成、实时网络/X/YouTube 研究、/obsidian-architect 代码文档化、Google Calendar 集成及反幻觉机制。基于 Karpathy LLM Wiki 模式，vault 自我更新并调和矛盾，助力构建不断进化的个人知识系统。
repos.summary_en: obsidian-second-brain transforms your Obsidian vault into a living AI-first second brain across Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode. With 43 commands, it delivers self-rewriting notes that update existing pages and auto-reconcile contradictions, following Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Features include live research from web/X/YouTube, /obsidian-architect for codebase docs, keyless research, Google Calendar integration, scheduled agents, role presets, and anti-hallucination tools, enabling autonomous knowledge compounding.

repos.summary_zh: Bypass Paywalls Clean for Chrome 是一款浏览器扩展，旨在帮助用户绕过新闻网站和在线出版物的付费墙限制。该扩展通过内容脚本和网络请求拦截技术，自动检测并规避付费订阅提示，使用户能够免费访问原本需要付费的内容。本仓库为扩展的专属支持与问题追踪平台，主代码已迁移至 gitflic.ru。
repos.summary_en: Bypass Paywalls Clean for Chrome is a browser extension designed to help users bypass paywalls on news sites and online publications. It employs content scripts and network request interception to automatically detect and circumvent paywall restrictions, allowing free access to premium content. This repository serves as the dedicated support and issue tracking platform, with the main codebase having been migrated to gitflic.ru.

repos.description: Exa MCP for web search and web crawling!
repos.summary_zh: Exa MCP Server 是 Exa Labs 推出的 Model Context Protocol 服务，为 AI 助手提供强大的网页搜索、代码检索和企业研究能力。该服务通过标准化接口将 Exa 的智能搜索技术无缝集成到 Cursor、VS Code、Claude 等主流开发环境，支持多种部署方式。开发者只需获取 API 密钥即可让 AI 具备实时网络信息获取和深度内容抓取能力，显著增强智能编程助手的上下文理解和数据检索功能。
repos.summary_en: The Exa MCP Server is a Model Context Protocol service by Exa Labs that equips AI assistants with advanced web search, code retrieval, and company research capabilities. It seamlessly integrates Exa's intelligent search technology into popular development environments like Cursor, VS Code, and Claude through standardized interfaces. Developers can easily connect via API key to enable AI assistants with real-time web information access and deep content crawling, dramatically enhancing context awareness and data retrieval for intelligent coding assistants.

repos.description: Chrome扩展：支持GPT（Codex） / kiro / Grok自动注册、上传
repos.summary_zh: FlowPilot是专注于ChatGPT账号全生命周期管理的Chrome自动化插件。它实现从注册、验证码处理、Plus支付到平台接入的完整自动化链路，支持多邮箱方案和支付渠道，具备智能重试与批量执行能力。适用于AI账号规模化运营场景，可高效处理数百账号的自动化流程。
repos.summary_en: FlowPilot is a specialized Chrome extension for automated lifecycle management of ChatGPT accounts. It orchestrates complete workflows from registration, CAPTCHA handling, Plus payment processing to platform integration. The tool supports multiple email providers, payment gateways, and verification services, featuring intelligent retry mechanisms and batch execution capabilities. Designed for large-scale AI account operations, it enables efficient management of hundreds of accounts with high success rates and comprehensive record tracking.

repos.description: Lossless Claw — LCM (Lossless Context Management) plugin for OpenClaw
repos.summary_zh: Lossless Claw 是 OpenClaw 的无损上下文管理插件，基于 LCM 论文实现。它通过 DAG 结构摘要系统解决 AI 代理长对话的 token 限制问题，将所有消息持久化到 SQLite 数据库，并使用 LLM 动态生成多层次摘要，确保对话历史完整可查。提供搜索工具让代理随时召回细节，实现永不遗忘的智能体体验。
repos.summary_en: Lossless Claw is a Lossless Context Management (LCM) plugin for OpenClaw that solves AI agents' context window limitations through innovative DAG-based summarization. Instead of truncating old messages, it persists every message in SQLite and creates hierarchical LLM-generated summaries, forming a directed acyclic graph that preserves all original details. The system dynamically assembles context by combining recent messages with relevant summaries, ensuring no information is ever lost. With built-in tools like lcm_grep and lcm_expand, agents can instantly search and retrieve any historical detail, delivering a seamless never-forget conversational experience while staying within model token constraints.

repos.description: An AI-Powered Speech Processing Toolkit and Open Source SOTA Pretrained Models, Supporting Speech Enhancement, Separation, and Target Speaker Extraction, etc.
repos.summary_zh: ClearerVoice-Studio是阿里巴巴开源的AI语音处理工具包，集成语音增强、分离、超分辨率及目标说话人提取等SOTA预训练模型。支持10+音频格式与立体声处理，提供灵活的NumPy接口和完整训练/推理脚本。其FRCRN降噪模型已在ModelScope被调用超300万次，为研究、开发和生产提供一站式解决方案。
repos.summary_en: ClearerVoice-Studio is an open-source AI-powered speech processing toolkit by Alibaba, featuring SOTA pretrained models for speech enhancement, separation, super-resolution, and target speaker extraction. Supporting 10+ audio formats with stereo processing, it offers flexible NumPy interfaces and comprehensive training/inference scripts. Its FRCRN denoiser has surpassed 3 million uses on ModelScope, delivering a production-ready solution for researchers and developers.

repos.description: Open-source GEO content engineering and multi-site distribution platform with AI quality inspection, illustrated admin help, hosted sites, browser-assisted publishing, and signed updates.
repos.summary_zh: GEOFlow 是开源的 GEO 内容工程与多站点分发系统，通过 AI 生成、RAG 知识库、素材管理和任务自动化，实现可信内容资产的全链路管理。支持多模型调用、智能审核、SEO 优化和静态页面分发，适用于大规模内容生产与多渠道发布场景。基于 Laravel 和 pgvector，提供 Docker 一键部署方案。
repos.summary_en: GEOFlow is an open-source GEO content engineering and multi-site distribution system that orchestrates AI generation, RAG knowledge bases, material management, and task automation into a sustainable workflow. It enables teams to transform trusted resources into manageable, publishable, and trackable content assets across multiple channels. Key features include multi-model AI integration, intelligent review, SEO optimization, static page generation, and analytics. Built on Laravel with PostgreSQL and pgvector, it offers Docker Compose deployment for scalable content operations.

repos.description: Curated list of AI-powered developer tools.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库系统性地整理了AI驱动的开发者工具生态，覆盖智能IDE、终端代理到自动化CI/CD的全链路场景。核心价值在于通过LLM增强代码生成、重构与调试效率，并引入多智能体编排和沙箱隔离技术实现安全自治。典型应用包括Cursor/Windsurf等AI-Native编辑器、PR审查机器人及数据库智能助手，是开发者迈向AI编程时代的导航地图。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates an ecosystem of AI-powered developer tools spanning intelligent IDEs, terminal agents, and automated CI/CD pipelines. It enhances coding efficiency through LLM-driven generation, refactoring, and debugging, while introducing multi-agent orchestration and sandboxing for secure autonomy. Key applications include AI-native editors like Cursor/Windsurf, PR review bots, and database assistants, serving as a roadmap for developers transitioning to AI-augmented programming.

repos.description: A browser extension that helps users publish content to multiple social media platforms with one click.
repos.summary_zh: 这款浏览器扩展MultiPost支持一键将内容同步发布到知乎、微博、小红书、抖音等10多个平台。无需任何登录或API Key，完全免费。提供扩展API和RESTful API便于开发者集成。解决了内容创作者跨平台发布的难题，提升效率。适用于社交媒体营销和内容自动化分发场景。
repos.summary_en: MultiPost is a browser extension that allows users to publish content such as text, images, and videos to over 10 social media platforms including Zhihu, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, and Douyin with just one click. No login, registration, or API key is needed, and the service is completely free. It provides an Extension API and a RESTful API for easy integration into web applications or scripts. This tool solves the challenges content creators face when posting across multiple platforms, greatly improving efficiency. It is ideal for social media marketing and automated content distribution scenarios, with a companion Markdown editor available.

repos.description: De-AI writing skill for any Agent Skills-compatible agent (77+ via the Skills CLI), with native plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, and Antigravity. Narrative-architecture repair for fiction, venue-matched rules for professional prose. Based on StoryScope (arXiv:2604.03136).
repos.summary_zh: sepia 是可移植的 Agent Skill，基于 StoryScope 研究，从叙事架构层消除 AI 写作痕迹。小说先修复因果与主题结构，再处理篇章与字句；专业文按场景（发版说明、PR、事故复盘等）匹配规则。支持 77+ 代理及 Claude Code、Codex、Grok 等原生插件，提供写、审、改、重写四种操作。
repos.summary_en: sepia is a portable Agent Skill that de-AIs writing at the architectural layer, based on StoryScope research. Fiction repairs narrative structure before style; professional prose applies venue-matched rules for release notes, PRs, postmortems and more. Works with 77+ agents via Skills CLI, plus native plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build and others, offering write, review, refactor and recreate operations.

repos.description: 全能协议分析工具：浏览器抓包 + MITM 代理 + 指纹伪装 + AI 分析 + MCP Server 无缝对接 AI Agent/IDE   |  All-in-one protocol analysis toolkit — built-in browser capture, MITM proxy, JS hooks, fingerprint spoofing, AI analysis & MCP server for agent integration
repos.summary_zh: Anything Analyzer是一款全能协议分析工具，集成内嵌浏览器抓包、MITM代理、JS Hook与AI大模型，支持网页、桌面应用、终端脚本及手机App的全场景流量捕获，所有请求统一汇入Session。AI实现两阶段智能分析、API逆向、安全审计、加密代码提取与流式报告，内置MCP Server/Client无缝对接AI Agent和IDE。基于Electron+React+TypeScript的跨平台桌面应用，显著提升协议逆向与调试效率。
repos.summary_en: Anything Analyzer is an all-in-one protocol analysis toolkit combining embedded browser capture (CDP), MITM proxy, JS hooks for fingerprint spoofing and encryption interception, and AI-powered analysis. It unifies traffic from websites, desktop apps, terminals, scripts, and mobile apps into sessions for automated API reverse engineering, security audits, JS encryption reversal, and more. Built-in MCP server/client enables seamless integration with AI agents and IDEs like Claude and Cursor. Developed with Electron, React, and TypeScript, it provides a cross-platform desktop solution to streamline protocol analysis and debugging.

repos.description: Deploy Your Frontend in a Single Command. Claude Code Skills supported.
repos.summary_zh: PinMe 是一款零配置的前端静态部署工具，通过单命令将构建产物上传至去中心化网络。无需服务器管理，自动处理可用性与持久性，提供可验证内容防止篡改。深度集成 AI 工作流，支持 Claude Code 等直接部署，兼容 React/Vue/Next.js 等主流框架，为开发者与 AI 代理提供极简发布体验。
repos.summary_en: PinMe is a zero-config static frontend deployment tool that publishes sites to decentralized networks with a single command. It eliminates server management, automatically handling availability and persistence while providing verifiable content to prevent tampering. With deep AI workflow integration supporting Claude Code, it offers a frictionless publishing experience for developers and AI agents, compatible with React/Vue/Next.js frameworks.

repos.description: A calm, open system for organizing life and work. Tasks, projects, notes, areas, and smart workflows - self-hosted or hosted.
repos.summary_zh: tududi是一款自托管任务管理工具，融合个人简洁性与专业项目组织能力。核心亮点包括智能递归任务系统（支持多种模式、完成触发机制）、Telegram集成、多层级结构（领域-项目-任务-子任务），以及24种语言支持。面向注重隐私与效率的个人及团队，提供开放API与响应式设计，实现数据自主可控的生产力提升。
repos.summary_en: tududi is a self-hosted task management tool that merges personal simplicity with professional project organization. Its core features include an intelligent recurring task system with multiple patterns and completion-based triggers, seamless Telegram integration, and a hierarchical structure (Areas > Projects > Tasks > Subtasks). Designed for privacy-conscious individuals and teams, it offers 24-language support, OpenAPI documentation, and responsive design for full data control and productivity across devices.

repos.description: A CLI for Twitter/X — feed, bookmarks, and user timeline in terminal
repos.summary_zh: 无需API密钥的Twitter/X终端客户端，支持浏览时间线、书签、搜索及发帖等完整功能。采用浏览器Cookie认证与TLS指纹模拟技术绕过检测，提供结构化JSON/YAML输出，专为AI智能体与自动化脚本设计，支持代理与速率限制规避。
repos.summary_en: Twitter/X CLI bypassing API keys via browser cookies and TLS spoofing. Full read/write operations with structured JSON/YAML output optimized for AI agents and automation scripts.

repos.description: Your Self-Hosted Knowledge Base
repos.summary_zh: NoteDiscovery 是一款轻量级自托管笔记与知识库应用，强调数据隐私与所有权。采用纯 Markdown 文件存储，支持知识图谱可视化、LaTeX 数学、Mermaid 图表、内置绘图编辑器及插件扩展。通过 MCP 协议实现与 Claude、Cursor 等 AI 助手的深度集成，支持笔记搜索、创建与组织。提供美观响应式界面、可选认证和多语言支持，是 Notion、Obsidian 的免费开源替代方案，适合开发者、知识工作者及隐私敏感用户，Docker 一键部署，无订阅费用与厂商锁定。
repos.summary_en: NoteDiscovery is a lightweight self-hosted note-taking and knowledge base application that empowers users with full control over their data. Notes are stored as plain Markdown files, featuring an elegant web UI with graph visualization, LaTeX/MathJax support, Mermaid diagrams, a drawing editor, and extensive customization via themes and plugins. It stands out with MCP integration for AI tools like Claude and Cursor, enabling direct note search, creation, and organization. Responsive across devices with optional auth and multi-language support, it serves as a free, open-source alternative to Notion or Obsidian for privacy-focused developers and knowledge workers, with effortless Docker deployment and zero subscriptions or lock-in.

repos.description: x64dbg-MCP Server is a native MCP (Model Context Protocol) plugin for x64dbg that exposes the debugger's full functionality over HTTP. Connect any MCP-compatible AI assistant and control x64dbg programmatically: set breakpoints, step through code, read memory, dump registers, and more.  Built with Zig — zero dependencies, single-binary output, cros
repos.summary_zh: x64dbg-MCP Server 是用 Zig 编写的原生 MCP 插件，为零依赖单文件，支持 x32/x64。它通过 HTTP/SSE 暴露 x64dbg 全部调试功能（断点、单步、内存读写、寄存器、反汇编、符号、PE分析等84个工具），让任何兼容 MCP 的 AI 助手可程序化控制调试器，实现智能体驱动的逆向工程。
repos.summary_en: x64dbg-MCP Server is a native Zig-built MCP plugin for x64dbg with zero dependencies and single-binary output for both x32/x64. It exposes full debugger capabilities (84 tools: breakpoints, stepping, memory, registers, disassembly, PE analysis, etc.) over HTTP/SSE, enabling any MCP-compatible AI assistant to programmatically control the debugger for agentic reverse engineering.

repos.description: A Calibre plugin to translate ebook into a specified language.
repos.summary_zh: Bookfere Ebook Translator 是为 Calibre 设计的专业翻译插件，集成 Google、DeepL、ChatGPT 等主流引擎及自定义 API 支持。插件全面兼容 Calibre 48 种输入格式，提供高级与批量双模式，支持多任务并行翻译与智能缓存，可无缝集成至 Calibre 库管理，是跨语言阅读与电子书本地化的技术解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Bookfere Ebook Translator is a professional Calibre plugin integrating Google Translate, DeepL, ChatGPT, Gemini, and custom APIs to translate ebooks across 48 input formats. It offers advanced and batch modes, parallel processing, intelligent caching, and seamless Calibre library integration, delivering a robust solution for cross-language reading and ebook localization with extensive customization options and format compatibility.

repos.summary_zh: Obsidian Digital Garden 插件将 Obsidian 知识库转化为精美数字花园网站。支持选择性发布（仅 dg-publish: true 笔记公开），保护隐私。全面兼容 Dataview、Canvas、Excalidraw、Mermaid 等功能，提供搜索、图谱、反向链接导航及主题/CSS 定制。基于 Eleventy 静态生成，通过 Vercel/Netlify 一键部署或 Forestry 托管，实现零成本、完全可控的知识分享与持续迭代。
repos.summary_en: The Obsidian Digital Garden plugin transforms Obsidian vaults into beautiful, customizable digital garden websites. It enables selective publishing via 'dg-publish: true' frontmatter for privacy control. It supports extensive Obsidian features including Dataview queries, Canvas, Excalidraw, Mermaid diagrams, plus advanced navigation like search, graphs, and backlinks. Customization includes themes, CSS variables, and custom components. Powered by Eleventy for static sites, it offers seamless deployment to Vercel/Netlify or managed hosting via Forestry.md, giving users full ownership of their evolving knowledge base.

repos.description: Google Antigravity AI模型配额监控插件 (Antigravity AI Model Quota Watching)
repos.summary_zh: AntigravityQuotaWatcher 是一款 VS Code 插件，专为 Antigravity AI 平台用户提供实时配额监控。通过自动检测服务端口与认证信息，在状态栏直观展示各模型剩余配额，并在配额不足时智能预警。内置 Dashboard 面板支持配额概览、连接状态检测及周限测试，帮助开发者有效管理 AI 资源，避免开发中断。
repos.summary_en: AntigravityQuotaWatcher is a VS Code extension that provides real-time quota monitoring for Antigravity AI platform users. It automatically detects service ports and authentication credentials, displays remaining quotas for various AI models in the status bar, and offers smart alerts when quotas are low. The built-in Dashboard panel provides quota overview, connection status, and weekly limit testing features, helping developers effectively manage AI resources and prevent development interruptions.

repos.description: AI deep-research agent that turns any question into a cited report: plans searches, reads real sources, verifies evidence. Self-hosted, multi-provider, Docker-ready.
repos.summary_zh: 基于深度研究的AI助手，通过迭代搜索与LLM实现自动化信息挖掘。支持DeepSeek R1等主流模型，提供树状可视化研究流程与实时流式反馈。采用浏览器本地化处理确保数据安全，集成Tavily/Firecrawl多源搜索。支持PDF导出与Docker部署，适用于学术研究、市场分析等深度调研场景。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered research assistant that automates deep information gathering through iterative search and LLM reasoning. Features real-time streaming feedback and tree-structured visualization of research processes. Supports DeepSeek R1 and major LLM providers with local browser processing for data privacy. Integrates Tavily and Firecrawl for web search, offers PDF export, Docker deployment, and server mode. Ideal for academic research, market analysis, and competitive intelligence requiring comprehensive, automated investigation with full citation tracking.

repos.description: A taxonomy for open source cryptocurrency, blockchain, and decentralized ecosystems
repos.summary_zh: Electric Capital 推出的 Open Dev Data 是一个结构化的区块链与 Web3 开源生态分类法。它提供 CLI 工具链，支持按时间快照导出 JSONL 格式的仓库数据，并集成 DuckDB 实现本地高性能分析。通过交互式 SQL 界面，开发者可快速洞察比特币、以太坊等生态的子系统分布与项目演进，为生态研究提供精准数据基础。
repos.summary_en: Open Dev Data by Electric Capital is a structured taxonomy for blockchain and Web3 open-source ecosystems. It offers a CLI toolkit to export repository data in JSONL format with historical snapshots, integrates DuckDB for local high-performance analytics, and provides an interactive SQL interface. Developers can quickly analyze subsystem distributions and project evolution across ecosystems like Bitcoin and Ethereum, enabling precise ecosystem research.

repos.description: A wrapper that exposes Google AI Studio Build as OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic compatible APIs.（一个将 Google AI Studio Build 封装为兼容 OpenAI / Gemini / Anthropic 风格 API 的工具）
repos.summary_zh: AIStudioToAPI 是一个将 Google AI Studio 网页端封装为兼容 OpenAI、Gemini 和 Anthropic API 格式的代理工具。它利用浏览器自动化技术实现多账号管理、工具调用及生图/TTS 模型访问，提供可视化 Web 控制台和 VNC 登录功能，便于开发者将 AI Studio 能力无缝集成到现有应用。
repos.summary_en: AIStudioToAPI is a wrapper that converts Google AI Studio's web interface into OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic-compatible API formats. Leveraging browser automation, it supports multi-account management, function calling, and access to Gemini models for image generation and text-to-speech. The tool provides a web console with VNC login capabilities, enabling seamless integration of AI Studio features into existing applications.

repos.description: Integrate Grok's powerful real-time search capabilities into Claude via the MCP protocol!
repos.summary_zh: 通过 MCP 协议将 Grok 实时搜索能力集成至 Claude，突破模型知识截止限制。基于 FastMCP 构建，提供 AI 优化的结构化搜索结果，支持多平台过滤与网页抓取。可一键禁用官方工具并强制路由，实现无缝即插即用。适用于事实核查、实时信息检索与研究分析场景，显著增强 AI 的时效性信息获取能力。
repos.summary_en: Integrates Grok's real-time search capabilities into Claude via MCP protocol, effectively breaking through the model's knowledge cutoff limitation. Built on FastMCP framework, it delivers AI-optimized structured search results with multi-platform filtering and web scraping support. Features one-click disabling of native tools with forced routing for seamless plug-and-play experience. Includes automatic time injection and dynamic model switching capabilities. Ideal for fact-checking, real-time information retrieval, and research analysis scenarios, significantly enhancing AI's ability to access up-to-date information and verify facts with current data.

repos.summary_zh: Isoflow 是基于 React 的开源网络图绘制组件，提供拖放编辑器、可扩展图标系统（支持 AWS/Azure 等云插件）和代码/图片导出功能。作为 MIT 许可的开源核心项目，社区版适用于 IT 基础设施可视化、云架构设计与网络拓扑规划场景。技术亮点在于灵活的插件机制与 React 组件的易集成性，助力快速构建专业网络文档。
repos.summary_en: Isoflow is an open-source React component for drawing network diagrams. It features a drag-and-drop editor, extensible icon system with plugins for AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and export options to code or images. As an MIT-licensed open-core project, the Community Edition is ideal for architecture visualization, infrastructure planning, and network topology scenarios. Highlights include plugin extensibility and seamless React integration.

repos.description: Portable AI code quality reviews for Codex, Cursor, Copilot and other coding agents: six Agent Skills for architecture, technical debt, tests and remediation.
repos.summary_zh: brooks-lint是一款基于《人月神话》等12本经典工程书籍的AI代码审查工具。它诊断代码中的6种衰退风险，输出带书籍引用、严重性标签和修复建议的结构化发现。支持PR审查、架构审计、技术债务评估、测试套件审查及全扫自动修复等6种模式。作为Claude Code插件和Codex CLI技能集成，提供一致、可追溯的代码质量评估。适用于软件开发团队提升可维护性、降低技术债务，超越传统linter和纯AI审查。
repos.summary_en: brooks-lint is an AI-powered code review tool grounded in twelve classic engineering books including The Mythical Man-Month and Refactoring. It diagnoses code across six decay risks such as Cognitive Overload and Change Propagation, producing structured findings with book citations, severity labels, and actionable remedies. Featuring six analysis modes including PR reviews, architecture audits, tech debt assessments, test suite reviews, and full-sweep auto-fix, it integrates as a Claude Code plugin and Codex CLI skill. This delivers consistent, traceable code quality insights superior to plain LLMs or traditional linters, ideal for software teams improving maintainability and reducing technical debt.

repos.description: 微信读书 koreader 插件，在 koreader 里阅读微信读书里的书籍、公众号文章，支持阅读进度同步，阅读时长上报和统计，本地书籍支持获取微信读书划线和想法内容，支持Kindle、Kobo等所有能安装 koreader 的设备。
repos.summary_zh: 微信读书 KOReader 插件，可在 Kindle、Kobo 等设备上阅读微信读书书籍与公众号文章，支持进度同步、时长统计、划线想法获取及章节预下载，打通封闭系统与微信读书生态。
repos.summary_en: KOReader plugin for WeRead on Kindle/Kobo: progress sync, reading stats, highlights, pre-download.

repos.description: 🤖 The largest directory for AI-ready documentation and tools implementing the proposed llms.txt standard
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个 llms.txt 标准的中央资源库，聚合了多种开发者工具与实现方案。通过标准化文档访问协议，指导 AI 模型精准理解项目文档，提升 AI 编程助手准确性与开发者体验。提供 Chrome 插件、VS Code 扩展、MCP 协议支持及 CLI 工具，覆盖主流开发环境，推动 LLM 与文档生态的互操作性。
repos.summary_en: The largest directory for the emerging llms.txt standard, curating production-ready implementations and developer tools across the ecosystem. It establishes a standardized protocol for how LLMs should access and interpret project documentation, significantly improving AI coding assistant accuracy and developer productivity. The hub provides Chrome extensions, VS Code plugins, Model Context Protocol integration, Raycast extensions, and CLI tools covering major development environments, fostering seamless interoperability between AI models and documentation ecosystems while setting clear boundaries for AI-content interaction.

repos.summary_zh: 该插件将微信消息通道深度集成至Claude Code，开发者可直接在终端收发微信消息。采用本地MCP服务器与HTTP长轮询技术，无需公网Webhook。通过二维码登录和配对码验证实现安全认证，并针对微信API的context_token机制优化，支持双向消息同步，无缝衔接开发工作流。
repos.summary_en: This plugin deeply integrates WeChat messaging channels into Claude Code, allowing developers to send and receive WeChat messages directly in the terminal without switching contexts. It employs a local MCP server with HTTP long-polling technology, eliminating the need for public webhooks. Features include QR code login, pairing code verification, and optimized handling of WeChat's context_token mechanism for bidirectional message synchronization, seamlessly integrating into developer workflows.

repos.description: Two Factor Authentication
repos.summary_zh: 基于Cloudflare Workers的全球加速网络，提供安全便捷的两步验证密钥管理服务。支持TOTP/HOTP自动生成、二维码扫描/图片识别添加、AES-256加密存储，兼容Google Authenticator等多平台导入导出，具备PWA离线使用与WebDAV/S3远程备份能力，适用于个人与企业多设备场景。
repos.summary_en: A secure two-factor authentication (2FA) key management service leveraging Cloudflare Workers for global acceleration. Features include automatic TOTP/HOTP generation, QR code scanning/image recognition for key addition, AES-256 encryption, and seamless import/export from platforms like Google Authenticator. With PWA offline support and remote backup via WebDAV/S3/OneDrive/Google Drive, it provides a unified solution across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

repos.description: Open-source SRS
repos.summary_zh: Memcode 是一款专为开发者与学习者设计的现代化间隔重复闪卡应用。核心亮点在于深度融合编程学习场景，支持代码块、LaTeX公式与多媒体内容，并集成 OpenAI 高质量文本转语音。其 LLM 友好的纯文本导入导出格式，便于 AI 辅助知识管理，实现美观、高效、无摩擦的学习体验。
repos.summary_en: Memcode is a modern spaced repetition flashcard app designed for developers and learners. It excels in programming education with support for code blocks, LaTeX formulas, and multimedia. Integrated OpenAI text-to-speech delivers high-quality audio, while LLM-friendly plain text import/export enables seamless AI-powered knowledge management, combining beauty with effortless learning.

repos.description: 工作流仓库 - dsh 插件的 .wflite.zip 工作流合集 by MingLin
repos.summary_zh: dsh-workflows 是配合 dsh-jailbreak-workflow 插件使用的现成工作流包，首个上架“破甲制作”工作流针对目标 LLM 实现系统性破甲研究自动化。流水线共 15 步，内置探针测试、拒绝模式分析、定制破甲词生成、API 验证及三件套输出，配套 Skill 含 10 个测试脚本与 4 套提示词模板，显著降低 LLM 安全研究门槛。
repos.summary_en: dsh-workflows is a ready-to-use workflow package for the dsh-jailbreak-workflow plugin. Its first workflow, 'Armor Breaking', automates systematic jailbreak research on target LLMs via a 15-step pipeline covering probe testing, refusal pattern analysis, customized jailbreak word generation, API validation, and three-part output. Bundled Skill includes 10 test scripts and 4 prompt templates, lowering the barrier for LLM security research.

repos.description: Google AI Studio and Gemini Web provider for Magpie (Gemini 4 Carbon / Hydrogen / Argon, Nano Banana image generation, Deep Research), backed by AIStudio2API and gemini-web2api-go
repos.summary_zh: Magpie 插件，通过本地后端将 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini 网页版转为 OpenAI 兼容接口，支持多账号额度调度、工具调用与实验性 Argon 模型，无需额外依赖。
repos.summary_en: A Magpie plugin that converts Google AI Studio and Gemini Web into OpenAI-compatible APIs through local backends. It automatically downloads and manages AIStudio2API and gemini-web2api-go, enabling users to access Google's large language models directly from Magpie without additional dependencies. Features include multi-account quota scheduling with per-account cards, native function calling for AI Studio, simulated tool calling for Gemini Web, cookie-based authentication, proxy support, and experimental Argon model access. Both providers can be configured simultaneously for flexible and diverse usage scenarios.

repos.description: 🐸 Read Frog | Open Source Immersive Translate - unofficial userscript port / 🐸 陪读蛙 | 开源沉浸式翻译 - 非官方油猴脚本
repos.summary_zh: rong6/read-frog 是 Read Frog 项目的非官方用户脚本移植仓库，将浏览器扩展适配为 Tampermonkey/Violentmonkey 脚本，支持移动浏览器运行。核心功能包括 AI 驱动的沉浸式翻译、文章分析及多模型支持，助力浏览器语言学习。技术亮点在于保留上游代码，仅替换平台实现，兼容移动端。适用于网页阅读翻译和深度语言掌握，尤其适合扩展不可用的移动场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides an unofficial userscript port of the Read Frog AI-powered language learning browser extension. It adapts the original extension for Tampermonkey and Violentmonkey userscripts, enabling use on mobile browsers where extensions are not supported. Features include immersive translation, article analysis, and compatibility with multiple AI models. The port keeps the core application logic intact while replacing extension platform components. It serves language learners by facilitating seamless web content translation and analysis directly in the browser, with particular value for mobile users.

repos.description: TypeScript SDK for the NitroPing audit log — batching client, error capture, Hono/Express/Nitro adapters, and GenAI cost tracing.
repos.summary_zh: nitroping-sdk 是 nitroping.dev 平台的官方多语言客户端库，支持 TypeScript、Swift、Python、Go、Kotlin、PHP 等语言，封装 REST API 实现设备令牌注册（APNs/FCM/Web Push）、多渠道通知发送（推送、邮件、SMS、Slack）、定向/定时/循环推送、Web Push 订阅与 UI 组件、内置收件箱及 Webhook 验证。适用于移动/Web 应用与服务器端通知集成，提供统一 API、公私钥认证和幂等性支持，实现跨平台一致体验。
repos.summary_en: nitroping-sdk offers official client libraries for the nitroping.dev platform across TypeScript, Swift, Python, Go, Kotlin, and PHP. It wraps the REST API for device token registration (APNs/FCM/Web Push), multi-channel notifications (push, email, SMS, Slack), targeted/scheduled/recurring sends, Web Push subscriptions with UI widgets, in-app inbox, and webhook verification. Ideal for mobile/web apps and servers needing unified, secure cross-platform notification delivery with public/secret key auth and idempotency.
